messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@helixai.com>, HelixAI Procurement <procurement@helixai.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Switching gears: HelixAI launch play & handoff

Team — attaching the signed SOW and contract. Quick summary up top so CS has context before the kickoff: 

- Account: HelixAI (startup, Series B)
- ARR / deal size: $312,000 annual commitment, Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) + Optimize add-on for first 6 months
- Signed: 2026-06-08 (DocuSign link included below)
- Start target: week of 2026-06-21 (requested by customer)

Critical success criteria (from commercial and customer):
1) End-to-end test integration with HelixAI dev environment within 10 business days of kickoff
2) 99th-percentile latency <= 250ms for 512-token prompts on their primary inference route
3) SSO + provisioning via SCIM and audit log delivery to their Splunk instance
4) Baseline token-cost reporting and per-route tracing visible in Redwood Console by day 10

Technical/context notes:
- Model: customer wants to run a finetuned open model (they call it "Helix-Base-v1"). They asked to pin the model version during ramp. Ops has verified compatibility on our dedicated pool but quantization profile recommended (FP16 -> int8) for latency/cost.
- Traffic profile: expected steady-state ~150 requests/minute with spikes up to 450 RPM during batch jobs; average prompt length ~420 tokens, response ~260 tokens.
- Data residency: US only; their legal asked for a private deployment option if we need it, but initial plan is Redwood Dedicated in us-west-2.
- Security/compliance: they completed our security questionnaire; SOC2 evidence pdf attached. Procurement asked for standard indemnity language — already accepted in the signed contract.

Risks / asks for CS:
- No Slack workspace set up yet; customer prefers Slack channel + weekly 30-min office hours first 30 days. Please create channel and invite Maya + Ravi.
- We need to validate their model artifact storage (S3 bucket permissions) before first integration test.
- Procurement requested automated monthly invoices put on PO HXA-PO-3321 (cc'd procurement).

Attachments: [Attachment: HelixAI_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf, 1.1MB)], [Attachment: HelixAI-signed-contract.pdf (application/pdf, 800KB)], [Attachment: initial-kickoff-agenda.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 45KB)]

Proposed first step: 60-minute kickoff with engineering + CS + procurement + product (customer suggests Tue 2026-06-22 10:00am PT). Can Marissa or Karthik own the handoff and lead the kickoff? Happy to be in the first meeting to intro and then transition to CS ownership.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Switching gears: HelixAI launch play & handoff

Thanks Ben — received and reviewed the SOW/contract. Happy to take point on the handoff; I’ll run kickoff and own the 0–30 day onboarding cadence. A few clarifying Qs before I send calendar invites: 

1) Model/version pin: can you confirm the exact artifact path or registry tag for "Helix-Base-v1" they intend to use? If they want a pinned variant we'll request a model snapshot and lock the runtime config.
2) Preferred auth for API calls during ramp: will they use client API keys (temporary) or immediate SSO (recommended)? If SSO is not ready by kickoff we can start with API keys and then rotate to SSO.
3) Routing: are we routing traffic through Dedicated pool only, or do they want a fallback to hosted in case of capacity issues? This affects test plan and burn rate assumptions.

Operational asks I’ll take on:
- Create #helixai-redwood Slack channel and invite Maya/Ravi by EOD tomorrow (Tessa, can you create the channel and add infra members?).
- Build a simple test plan for the first integration run (I’ll drop a checklist doc to the channel).
- Schedule weekly 30-min office hours for first 4 weeks and a 60-min business-review at week 4 to check SLOs and cost metrics.

I’ve attached a lightweight onboarding checklist we use for Dedicated customers. 

Marissa Cole
Principal Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: onboarding-checklist-dedicated.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)]
